fields.value: Keep eval inference diagnostics readable across interruption and reruns

An interrupted local shared eval left invalid artifacts/agents/batches.json. QA retained 75 of 120 matches, and the next pass ran the remaining 45, but overwrote the original batch evidence. Two compatible-inference groups in one experiment can also write to the same local artifact path. Topology and sizing are available on stderr only.

Give each local eval execution its own durable inference evidence. Keep completed batch observations readable after interruption and cancellation without extending the caller deadline. Preserve the original evidence on resume and across groups, and retain the mode, sizing and checkpoint allowance next to the batch observations. Verify this through an interrupted run and a resumed run while asserting the existing match-retention behavior. Keep artifact location and format changes explicit for existing readers.

Evidence: Etude PR #152, Task 310ac1 scratch/qa.html (Interrupt and resume), scratch/concept-review.html (F2a/F2b). CLI interrupt exit status is tracked under EXP-59.
